description: Performs repeated outbound HTTP GET requests to a controlled C2-style endpoint using the .NET WebClient API. Each beacon includes host metadata, username, sequence number, and UNIX timestamp in query parameters. The sample uses a browser-like User-Agent string and randomized sleep jitter between beacon attempts.
